attBesluta.text: I love the completeness of this set within its size range. Even the spark plug sockets are well represented. Another big plus is the compactness and organization of the carrying case. A few sockets were not held well, but most were, and of course, nothing comes loose when the case is closed. The set is easy to carry and to draw individual items from as needed.

this product had more going for than I saw in the picture. I also ordered the socket organizers as this was to heavy to just carry around. I have needed it several times this week and not one have a found a bolt not covered. they are stron and look like they will lag many years
